**Deep within their mountain holds, the Dwarfs stand defi ant — as unyielding as the cold stone beneath their boots.** 

Explore the rich history of the Dwarfs' mountain strongholds and their time-honoured traditions in this comprehensive guide for players who want to delve deep into the heart of Karaz Ankor! 

**Dwarf Player’s Guide** provides everything Players need to truly become one of the Children of Th e Grungni. Packed with exciting new Careers, Weapons, Vehicles, Runic Magic and much more.
